notes:
Tawny 0.1.3, a dev build. The Android APK is debug-signed, for sideloading: it installs over other debug and adb-installed builds of Tawny, not over a release-keystore build.

Tawny's releases now live in this repository, Gateway3B/tawny. From 0.1.3 the app checks https://github.com/Gateway3B/tawny/releases/latest/download/latest.json for updates; 0.1.2 installs find this release through g3techhq/releases and move over by updating.

Changes since 0.1.2 (5b17a9a):
- feat(updates)!: publish releases to Gateway3B/tawny
- chore(release): tawny 0.1.3
